publication_name: Assets and Liabilities of Commercial Banks in the United States (H.8)
access_description: Board public H.8 statistical release. Series B1001NCBA is bank credit for all commercial banks, seasonally adjusted. The code and the description line are taken from the Board data file. Live observations are weekly levels in millions of US dollars from the package at https://www.federalreserve.gov/datadownload/Output.aspx?rel=H8&filetype=zip. No FRED series is used.
auth_requirement: No key is described for the public H.8 data package.
conditions: Cite the Board. This row is weekly bank-credit volumes, not lending standards. Omit ND and blank periods, never store zero for a missing value, and do not interpolate. Do not copy Board seals or non-Board material.
revision_behaviour: The Board package is the latest revised release. It is latest-revised, not a vintage panel. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row.
unresolved_questions: The disclaimer does not discuss AI processing or AI model training. The Data Download Program is due to remove its package builder in the week of 9 November 2026. This row does not switch to FRED.
evidence_note: On 22 October 2026 the Board H.8 package returned HTTP 200. The file confirms series B1001NCBA with the description line Bank credit, all commercial banks, seasonally adjusted. The frequency in the file is weekly (Wednesday) and the unit is millions of US dollars. The series is latest-revised, not a vintage panel. An in-memory read found 2806 observations from 1973-01-03 to 2026-10-07, with no ND weeks, and was not written to the development database. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consumes fed.h8.B1001NCBA. Sahm and PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE require bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids.
